title: 1968 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Monkey
seo_title: 1968 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Monkey (30 January – 16 February 1969)
description: 1968 is the Year of the Earth Monkey (Yang, Wu-shen), from 30 January 1968 to 16 February 1969. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1968.
lead: Born in 1968? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Monkey, but check the date: the 1968 Earth Monkey year began on 30 January 1968. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1968: Year of the Earth Monkey, from 30 January 1968 to 16 February 1969.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1968 was the Year of the Monkey. It began with Lunar New Year on 30 January 1968 and ended on 16 February 1969, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1968 ends in 8, which makes it an Earth year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1968 is a Wu-shen year. The same Earth Monkey combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1908 before it and 2028 after it.
Lunar New Year 1968 fell on 30 January 1968. Anyone born from 1 January 1968 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Goat; from 30 January 1968 on, the Monkey.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Monkey guide describes the sign like this: “Clever, curious, and witty. Monkeys are quick learners who enjoy solving problems creatively.” The usual watch-out: “Can be mischievous or struggle to focus on one thing.”

The Earth element adds its own flavour. Earth years bring stability, practicality, and patience. People of this element tend to be dependable, grounded, and good at long-term planning. Read more in our Earth element guide, or the full Year of the Monkey page.
Careers often linked with the Monkey: technology, marketing, comedy, consulting.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1968
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Monkey's best matches are the Rat, Dragon and Snake, and its clash sign is the Tiger, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Monkey, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Monkey, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Monkey years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1956 (Fire Monkey); 1980 (Metal Monkey); 1992 (Water Monkey). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1968 is the Year of the Monkey, a Yang Earth Monkey year (Wu-shen).
When does the 1968 Year of the Monkey start and end?
It starts on 30 January 1968 and ends on 16 February 1969.
I was born in January 1968. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 30 January 1968, you are a Goat; from 30 January 1968 on, a Monkey.
Earth. 1968 ends in 8, which belongs to Earth, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Monkey compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Dragon and Snake. The Monkey's clash sign is the Tiger.
